pharmacology.text: 5F-ADBICA (also known as 5F-ADB-PICA) is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist at CB1 receptors and CB2 receptors with EC50 values of 0.77 nM and 1.2 nM respectively.

uses.en: It has been sold as a designer drug, usually sprayed onto herbal smoking mixtures. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾被當作設計藥物販售，通常噴灑在草本吸食混合物上，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被当作设计药物贩售，通常喷洒在草本吸食混合物上，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Synthetic cannabinoids as a group can cause anxiety, paranoia, a racing heart, vomiting, confusion and psychosis, and have been linked to seizures, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths. Regular use can lead to dependence and difficult withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整體而言可能引起焦慮、偏執、心跳過快、嘔吐、意識混亂和精神病症狀，也曾與癲癇發作、腎損傷、心臟病發作和死亡有關。規律使用可能導致依賴和難熬的戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整体而言可能引起焦虑、偏执、心跳过快、呕吐、意识混乱和精神病症状，也曾与癫痫发作、肾损伤、心脏病发作和死亡有关。规律使用可能导致依赖和难熬的戒断症状。

fact.en: The ICA in its name 5F-ADBICA stands for indole carboxamide. Close relatives whose names end in INACA, such as 5F-ADB-PINACA, have an indazole core instead.
fact.zh: 5F-ADBICA 名稱中的 ICA 代表吲哚甲醯胺。名稱以 INACA 結尾的近親，例如 5F-ADB-PINACA，則是以吲唑為核心。
fact.zhHans: 5F-ADBICA 名称中的 ICA 代表吲哚甲酰胺。名称以 INACA 结尾的近亲，例如 5F-ADB-PINACA，则是以吲唑为内核。
